Implemented the complete responsive course registration app in `/work`:

- `index.html`, `courses.html`, `registration.html`, `profile.html`
- Shared `styles.css`, sample course data, and no-build JavaScript
- Live search and filters, 16 courses, localStorage-backed registrations and profile editing
- Accessible confirmation/drop dialogs, form validation, schedule tables, keyboard navigation, and responsive layouts
